source_metadata.title: Methicillin-resistant Macrococcus canis in a human wound
source_metadata.source_type: short communication; single-patient clinical isolate and genomic characterization

duplicate_review.note: No cross-batch merge was required; source was processed as a single 3-page publication.

extraction_limitations: The current LiteratureAtom schema is not tailored to microbiology isolate/genomic measurements; quantitative microbial/genomic results were represented with the isolate as an exposure context to satisfy the quantitative_result sufficiency contract.

MIC inequalities (≤ or >) cannot be represented natively in the numeric estimate field; the boundary value is stored in estimate, while the exact inequality is preserved in canonical_statement and original_result_text and tagged as upper_bound or lower_bound.
The report provides no clinical treatment course or patient outcome, so none was inferred.
The wound culture was polymicrobial, and no dog samples were obtained; causal attribution and canine origin therefore remain unproven in the source.
schema_gaps: No dedicated atom kind for isolate identification/genomic architecture.
No native operator field for censored/inequality MIC values.
QuantitativeResult requires an exposure even for descriptive laboratory/genomic measurements.
